title: Promise-preserving polynomial reduction
statement: For binary promise problems $A$ and $B$, a polynomial-time reduction from $A$ to $B$ is a polynomial-time computable map on Boolean strings that sends every yes-instance of $A$ to a yes-instance of $B$ and every no-instance of $A$ to a no-instance of $B$.
hypotheses_covered: The source and target are binary promise problems
Every source yes-instance maps to a target yes-instance
Every source no-instance maps to a target no-instance
